name: Order of Wallachia
description:
About This Game

This is the story of Remus, an honoured member of Wallachia's Order. Mysterious disappearances and a new trail of his lost brother, Romulus, sent him to the lands of Kronstadt.

Setting. Kronstadt:

Welcome to 1600’s Kronstadt, one of the most important cities of Transylvania at that time.

Its mighty walls and powerful guilds have prepared many quests, secrets, and adventures for you.

Remus

The protagonist of our story is Remus, a member of the Order of Wallachia.

From early childhood, he and his twin brother, Romulus, fought side by side against the evil that spread across the lands of Wallachia. After the storming of Bran Castle in 1585, Remus’s fate would never be the same.

Gameplay. Fighting

Unravel dark secrets rooted in Romanian mythology and fight creatures from traditional folklore: the Moroi, Strigoi, Capcauns, Iele, and other nightmares that defy nature itself. Explore ancient dacian lands, villages and catacombs in your quests to complete the Order's mission. Engage in gritty, first-person combat with weighty swordplay, precise crossbow shots, and powerful flintlock blasts. Instantly switch between melee and ranged weapons to survive the monstrous spawn of Dracula that lurk behind every shadow. Be careful! The sky has 3 pairs of eyes.

Crafting

The lands of Transylvania have prepared countless trials for you. To overcome them, craft special potions and bombs, hunt animals using traps, master the art of alchemy and ancient recipes to survive the dangers and grow stronger.
short_desc: A first-person action-adventure set in the medieval town of Kronstadt. Uncover dark secrets, battle Romanian folklore-inspired monsters, and fight back against the evil that plagues the land using various weaponry.
